text.description_html:
Emtek 8058E-8058HT, Split Style Knob with #8 Rose Egg Knob Exterior and Hampton Knob Interior

This is a split style / split finish knobset. On the exterior is the Egg Knob with #8 Roset in US15 Satin Nickel. On the interior is The Hampton Crystal Knob with #8 Rose in Satin Brass.

Information for the Split Style and Split Finish Knobset with #8 Arched Rose:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Knob is surface mounted (rosette screws to the door's face).
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4 - 3"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Specifications for the Exterior Egg Knob

  • Exterior Knob Style: Egg Knob
  • Exterior Finish: US15 Satin Nickel
  • Exterior Knob Height: 2-1/2"
  • Exterior Knob Width: 1-1/2"
  • Exterior Knob Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Knob Stem: 1"
Specifications for the Interior Hampton Knob
  • Interior Knob Style: Hampton Crystal Egg Knob
  • Interior Finish: US4 Satin Brass
  • Interior Knob Height: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Knob Width: 1-11/16"
  • Interior Knob Projection: 3-1/4"
  • Interior Knob Stem: 1-3/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Rose Height: 4-3/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Rose Width: 2-9/16"

Available Functions:

  • Double Dummy for Pre-Drilled Doors: No door latch. Door knobs on both sides of the door. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, thru-bore dummy mounting kit, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside knob will release privacy push button and retract the door latch. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
